a.lede: Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.
a.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia

b.lede: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal.
b.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
